name: hausbank-agent
description: HausbankAgent: primarily Deutsche Bank capabilities, plus PSD2 access to ~9200 European banks. The embedded banking app is the multi-banking brain (statements, account data, payment flows). This plugin helps Claude use the connector well — setup, dashboard, vendors/customers, payment drafts, approval, send-to-bank, SWIFT/UETR, payment search (where is my payment).
